integrity: Direct formal-local and function-field proof with independently reproducible finite corroboration; no external validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns a single projective plane model over an algebraically closed field. It does not construct a stable or regular arithmetic model. The bad reduction of the Klein quartic in characteristic seven is known; novelty is claimed for the uniform exact cusp type, intrinsic singular-scheme length and normalization-genus law. An equivalent classification in unidentified Delsarte-curve or wild Kummer literature remains possible.
title: Wild cusps and normalization genera of Klein plane curves
